₿ Bitcoin in 2026: a new lower low.

📈 It started the year at about $88,738 and closed at a year high of $96,955 on 14 January.
📉 On 30 June it closed at $58,524, the level many traders watched as the floor for the year.
🔁 It bounced back to about $83,556 by the end of September.
⚠️ Today (21 Nov, 09:50 SAST) it was about $57,810, below that 30 June close, after touching $55,106, its lowest price of 2026 so far.

That's down about 35% since 1 January and about 40% from the January high.

Crypto prices can swing sharply both ways. Education, not financial advice.

What do you think comes next for Bitcoin? 👇
